format:
  revealjs:
    incremental: false

      <style>
      /* title slide */
      .reveal .subtitle .sub-line { display: inline-block; margin: 0.15em 0; font-size: 0.9em; }
      .reveal .subtitle .sub-line.dim { opacity: 0.72; }

      /* reveal.js default turns bold text blue on the dark theme — override */
      .reveal strong, .reveal b { color: inherit; }

      /* failure-mode motif: amber is used for nothing else in this deck */
      .fail {
        background: #FAEADC;
        color: #1c1c1c;
        border-left: 4px solid #B4551C;
        border-radius: 6px;
        padding: 0.65em 0.95em;
        margin: 0.7em 0;
      }
      .fail p { margin: 0.35em 0; color: #1c1c1c; }
      .fail strong, .fail b { color: #1c1c1c; }
      .fail code { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.08); color: #1c1c1c; }
      .lbl { color: #B4551C; font-weight: 700; }
      .maps { color: #cdd6d3; font-size: 0.82em; margin-top: 0.6em; }
      .maps strong, .maps b { color: #f0f0ee; }
      .tier { color: #7FA99B; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-size: 0.6em; }
      .reveal table { font-size: 0.72em; }
      </style>
